sentences.text: When an AI agent says it "remembers" you, is that architecture or marketing?
sentences.text_raw: When an AI agent says it "remembers" you, is that architecture or marketing?

sentences.text: Agents forget, so you re-enter the same details; the claim is a loop — query plus memory data from a datastore of your past interactions, into a sequence model, out as a response.
sentences.text_raw: Agents forget, so you re-enter the same details; the claim is a loop — query plus memory data from a datastore of your past interactions, into a sequence model, out as a response.

sentences.text: This datastore is not a transcript of your chats.
sentences.text_raw: This datastore is not a transcript of your chats.

sentences.text: Each memory object is a container holding memory values, a string, an image, or audio, plus metadata such as a timestamp, the trigger that stored it, and a summary of the interaction it came from.
sentences.text_raw: Each memory object is a container holding memory values, a string, an image, or audio, plus metadata such as a timestamp, the trigger that stored it, and a summary of the interaction it came from.

sentences.text: A model decides what to store: cached inputs go to the model system, which predicts what is worth remembering and extracts it.
sentences.text_raw: A model decides what to store: cached inputs go to the model system, which predicts what is worth remembering and extracts it.

sentences.text: It is stored as a memory value in a memory object, and one trigger is you asking the agent to remember your favorite architect.
sentences.text_raw: It is stored as a memory value in a memory object, and one trigger is you asking the agent to remember your favorite architect.

sentences.text: At query time the agent does not reread everything; it ranks stored objects by relevance to your query.
sentences.text_raw: At query time the agent does not reread everything; it ranks stored objects by relevance to your query.

sentences.text: It compares a query embedding to memory value embeddings by a measure such as cosine similarity, keeps a top subset, and orders them by timestamp.
sentences.text_raw: It compares a query embedding to memory value embeddings by a measure such as cosine similarity, keeps a top subset, and orders them by timestamp.

sentences.text: Memories are corrected: new timestamped input is matched to the prior memory object it concerns, which is then replaced or updated.
sentences.text_raw: Memories are corrected: new timestamped input is matched to the prior memory object it concerns, which is then replaced or updated.

sentences.text: Aligned objects can be consolidated into one, and a contradiction refines the matched memory rather than overcorrecting it.
sentences.text_raw: Aligned objects can be consolidated into one, and a contradiction refines the matched memory rather than overcorrecting it.

sentences.text: Forgetting is claimed: "forget that" deletes the specified information, and "forget this after three months" queues it for deletion.
sentences.text_raw: Forgetting is claimed: "forget that" deletes the specified information, and "forget this after three months" queues it for deletion.

sentences.text: Objects past their expiration time are deleted during maintenance, and the same chat that builds the memory erases it.
sentences.text_raw: Objects past their expiration time are deleted during maintenance, and the same chat that builds the memory erases it.

sentences.text: The model first works through your query against the recalled memory data, and that working-out can stay off the screen.
sentences.text_raw: The model first works through your query against the recalled memory data, and that working-out can stay off the screen.

sentences.text: What comes back can be an API call that makes a device act, so the memory shapes what the agent does, not only what it says.
sentences.text_raw: What comes back can be an API call that makes a device act, so the memory shapes what the agent does, not only what it says.

sentences.text: What is claimed is structural: memory objects made from your interactions, some on your explicit request, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, and deleted when you ask.
sentences.text_raw: What is claimed is structural: memory objects made from your interactions, some on your explicit request, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, and deleted when you ask.

sentences.text: That is a described architecture, not a slogan.
sentences.text_raw: That is a described architecture, not a slogan.
